skills.title: Researching Biodiversity and Space
skills.description: Put the steps of a research in order. Pick a good question about living things, electricity, flight, or space and the best place to find the answer.

skills.title: Fair Tests With Circuits and Flight
skills.description: Pick the fair test that changes only one thing, like testing how wing shape changes a glider's flight. Put the steps of an experiment in order.

skills.title: Design, Build, Test Flying Devices
skills.description: Put the steps for designing and building a device in order. Pick what to change to make it work better.

skills.title: Staying Safe With Electricity
skills.description: Pick the safe way to use tools, batteries, and materials. Choose the right gear to wear for the job.

skills.title: Sharing Findings With Others
skills.description: Pick the best way to share what you found for different people and reasons. Match science words to what they mean.

skills.title: Code That Gets Input
skills.description: Look at a few lines of code that get input, like a key press, a button, or a sensor. Pick what the code will do with it.

skills.title: Coding, New Tech, and Trades
skills.description: Pick how coding and new technology change everyday life and jobs, including skilled trades.

skills.title: Science in Jobs and Subjects
skills.description: Match jobs, including skilled trades, to the science they use to fix real problems. Pick how science works with other subjects to help.

skills.title: Science Ideas From Many Communities
skills.description: Match science and technology ideas to the communities that gave them to us. Pick how those ideas help people.

skills.title: Sorting Living Things Into Groups
skills.description: Pick what makes groups of living things different, like animals, plants, and fungi. Sort living things into smaller groups using a classification key.

skills.title: What Is Biodiversity?
skills.description: Pick that biodiversity is the variety of life: differences inside a species, between species, and between habitats.

skills.title: Variety Helps a Species Survive
skills.description: Pick how differences among members of one species, like colour or disease resistance, help the species survive.

skills.title: Variety Keeps Communities Strong
skills.description: Pick how having many species and habitats helps a community bounce back from change, like a drought or disease.

skills.title: Living Things Rely on Each Other
skills.description: Match relationships, like pollination, predators and prey, and sharing food, to how they keep biodiversity going.

skills.title: Invasive Species
skills.description: Pick how invasive species, like zebra mussels, crowd out native living things and lower biodiversity.

skills.title: Climate Change and Lost Species
skills.description: Pick how a warming climate makes living things lose their habitats and what happens when biodiversity is lost.

skills.title: Biodiversity and Farming
skills.description: Pick how many kinds of crops, pollinators, and soil life help farms, including Indigenous farming around the world.

skills.title: Why Biodiversity Matters
skills.description: Pick the benefits of biodiversity for people and nature. Pick what happens when biodiversity shrinks.

skills.title: Solving a Local Biodiversity Problem
skills.description: Look at a local problem, like a drained wetland. Pick the different points of view and the best plan to help.

skills.title: Static Electricity
skills.description: Pick why things like a balloon rubbed on hair stick or spark. Pick that charges can attract or push away.

skills.title: Current and Static Electricity
skills.description: Pick that current electricity is charges flowing along a path. Compare it with static electricity.

skills.title: Conductors and Insulators
skills.description: Sort materials, like copper, rubber, and plastic, into ones that let electricity flow and ones that block it.

skills.title: Making Electrical Energy
skills.description: Match technologies, like solar panels, wind turbines, and batteries, to the energy they turn into electricity.

skills.title: Electricity Turns Into Other Energy
skills.description: Match devices, like lamps, toasters, and fans, to the energy electricity turns into, like light, heat, or motion.

skills.title: Parts of a Simple Circuit
skills.description: Label the cell, wires, switch, and bulb in a circuit. Pick what each part does.

skills.title: Series and Parallel Circuits
skills.description: Tell series circuits from parallel circuits in pictures. Match each one to where it is used, like string lights or house outlets.

skills.title: Making Electricity in Canada
skills.description: Pick short-term and long-term effects of ways to make electricity in Canada on people, First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, nature, and climate.

skills.title: Using Less Electricity
skills.description: Pick choices that use less electricity at home and school. Pick the best way to get your school to use it wisely.

skills.title: Air and Flight
skills.description: Pick how properties of air, like pressure and air pushing back, are used in flying things like kites, wings, and parachutes.

skills.title: The Four Forces of Flight
skills.description: Match lift, weight, thrust, and drag to what each one does. Pick how they balance in flight.

skills.title: Controlling Flight
skills.description: Pick how balanced and unbalanced forces help planes and birds climb, glide, turn, and land.

skills.title: Changing the Forces of Flight
skills.description: Pick how wing shape, engine power, and weight change lift, thrust, drag, and weight.

skills.title: How Living Things Fly
skills.description: Match features of birds, bats, and insects, like hollow bones and light bodies, to how they help them fly.

skills.title: Aviation and Our World
skills.description: Pick good and bad effects of planes and drones on people and nature, near home and around the world.

skills.title: Parts of the Solar System
skills.description: Match the Sun, planets, moons, comets, asteroids, and meteoroids to their main features.

skills.title: Mass and Weight
skills.description: Pick the difference between mass, how much matter something has, and weight, how hard gravity pulls it.

skills.title: Gravity and Weight
skills.description: Pick how weight changes on the Moon or other planets because gravity is different, while mass stays the same.

skills.title: Bodies That Shine or Reflect
skills.description: Sort space bodies, like stars and the Sun, that make light from ones, like moons and planets, that reflect it.

skills.title: Earth, Moon, and Sun Motions
skills.description: Pick effects of how Earth, the Moon, and the Sun move, like moon phases, eclipses, and tides.

skills.title: Space Exploration Technology
skills.description: Match tools like telescopes, satellites, probes, and rovers to what they taught us about space.

skills.title: Living and Working in Space
skills.description: Pick how space affects the body and feelings of astronauts. Pick how they get food, exercise, sleep, and contact with family.

skills.title: Watching Earth From Space
skills.description: Pick how satellites help us see changes on Earth, like melting ice, forest loss, and climate change.

skills.title: Space Exploration and Our World
skills.description: Pick good and bad effects of space exploration on people and the environment, like space junk and new inventions. Think about different points of view.
